title: November 17 — distributed context and off-token imagination
summary: Three Nov 17 repositories; Qwenimagination's Nov 18 update confirms item-specific off-token transfer on pretrained Qwen but not durable native write/retrieval. TuftSheet and TuftSheetSol findings and limits remain as documented.

nodes.claim: A 24-column, horizontally diffusive context sheet replaces WaveCortex's single global apical rule to represent two independent changing latent rules.
nodes.survived: Five of six pre-registered tests pass in 32 source-reported bodies. Uniform-sheet sign accuracy 0.80 vs global g 0.69, unlinked 0.59 and ideal 0.88; post-switch neighbor transfer 0.81 vs no-links 0.40; unchanged-region stability 0.94; causal g cut to chance 0.50.
nodes.killed: T6 local boundary learning fails (22/32 versus required 24/32); correct boundary weakest in only 3/32. Learned links are worse than uniform (0.76 versus 0.80). Column order, two regions and diffusion rates supplied. This is a diffusive message field, not a physical travelling wave.
nodes.era: November 17: spatial inner worlds and off-token memory

nodes.claim: A dependency-free browser lab separates stored local world context from a second excitable reaction–diffusion medium, and perturbs only a hand-specified perceptual readout.
nodes.survived: Six numerical gates reportedly pass in all 32 held learning seeds: two fixed-rule contexts reach sign accuracy 1.000; at +50 ticks seeded coupling adds 0.3351 readout MSE relative to uncoupled; front radius 22.36 cells; by +160 excess MSE relative to sham is 0.000105.
nodes.killed: Midpoint weak boundary is supplied, perceptual impairment coupling is hand-coded and equality of internal context under sensory blackout is ensured by design. The 32 seeds do not vary the underlying deterministic disturbance physics. Not a biological migraine-aura model or evidence for phenomenal qualia.
nodes.era: November 17: spatial inner worlds and off-token memory

nodes.claim: Frozen Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct contains item-specific concept information that can be extracted and transported outside its text context; later experiments separate answer-time injection from genuine delayed retrieval.
nodes.survived: V2: 18/60 (30%) held-out exact recall with derived concept write at answer-time versus 1/60 (2%) no write and 0/60 cue or shuffled. V3 replicates 11/50 (22%) versus 1/50 none. Direct bag reader recovers 29/60 and 25/50. V6 clean answer-word write at final token: 46/60.
nodes.killed: V1 failed all gates. V3 tuft selector did not improve baseline. V4 engineered role binder cannot test learned roles. V5 derived and oracle one-shot delayed writes yield 0/232 exact retrieval. V6 pre-question write yields 2/60. V7 category run is inconclusive because the printed-word positive control also fails (always predicts A); external category reader reaches 91.25%. No autonomous imagination, learned binding, or persistent native memory shown.

edges.why: Normalized apical W+gV gated learning is reused with local context at each column.
WaveCortex's more accurate scalar relational-column version forms the local computational unit; one global g becomes a spatial context field.
The paper motivates multi-region world modeling; this is a documented conceptual bridge, not source-code inheritance.
An independently written JS context field carries the sheet idea and adds a separate excitable medium and readout, not the original Python engine.
A sustained local belief/context loop becomes the motivation for a recurrent residual-space LM state; the real-model experiment is not run.
Both ask how a latent prediction might persist independently of emitted content, but this is conceptual and does not imply phenomenal experience.

motifs.title: Many local latent contexts instead of one global rule
motifs.description: A spatially diffusive scalar context field can hold two independently changing simple hidden rules, while the attempted unsupervised boundary learner fails.

motifs.title: The stored world and its readout medium can be distinguished
motifs.description: A numerical perturbation of a separate excitable field can change designed perceptual readout without overwriting representation, but the impairment coupling is supplied.

motifs.title: Can a derived thought outlast the text that evoked it?
motifs.description: Actual pretrained Qwen supports externally transported concept information, but one-shot delayed writes and later native retrieval remain unshown.
